spans.text: **No backend infers Set types from schema.** No offline store (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Spark, Athena, MSSQL) maps its native types to Feast Set types.
spans.note: The prompt is highly transparent about limitations, backend support gaps, and known issues. It explicitly documents which types cannot be inferred, which backends have limitations, and known round-trip data loss behaviors (e.g., empty inner collections becoming None).
